import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlBu_r', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=50)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality (colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Physical Activity Level distribution by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
box_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == category]['Physical Activity Level'] for category in bmi_order]
bp = axes[0, 1].boxplot(box_data, labels=bmi_order, patch_artist=True)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity Level by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
colors = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral', 'gold']
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)

# 3. Daily Steps distribution by Occupation (top 6 occupations)
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().nlargest(6).index
occupation_data = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=occupation_data, x='Occupation', y='Daily Steps', ax=axes[0, 2], 
            order=top_occupations, palette='Set2')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation (Top 6)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Heart Rate distribution by Age Groups
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                         labels=['15-25', '26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Age Group', y='Heart Rate', ax=axes[1, 0], palette='coolwarm')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sleep Disorder prevalence by Gender
disorder_counts = df.groupby(['Gender', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
disorder_counts.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 1], color=['lightgray', 'lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Disorder Prevalence by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='RdBu_r', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=axes[1, 2])
axes[1, 2].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
